title: chaosD6 effect definition (chaosd6.effect/2; /1 = /2 without `standing`) and effect library (chaosd6.effect-lib/1)
description: Structural schema. Semantic checks (known operations, known subroutines, outcome keys, statuses) are done by effect-engine.mjs#validateEffectDef / validateLib; see SCHEMA.md.

logic.description: A JsonLogic-dialect program: a primitive, an array (evaluated element-wise) or an object with exactly ONE key (the operation).

source.description: Where the metadata came from (data/effects.json active version) — provenance only.

elements.description: The card's element cost, in emission order.

every.description: ∀ (double cast) behaviour, documentation for UI / validator; the logic reads cast.every itself.

flags.description: Resolver metadata peer.mjs / bots read (exactly the EFFECT_RULES entry: damage, scope, range, permanent, statBuy, fixedPower, channel, trap, tileTarget, …). Not read by the logic.

uses.description: Library ids whose subroutines `call` may use (searched in order).

standing.description: chaosd6.effect/2 only (effect isolation F2): what the permanent does while it stands — hook → program (game/effect-standing.mjs; SCHEMA.md "Standing programs").

bot.description: chaosd6.effect/2 only (effect isolation F8): how bots treat the card — monster deck themes and npc casting hints (game/monster-deck.mjs). Never read by a resolver.

tags.description: Creature tags the effect suits (+5 thematic score).

names.description: Case-insensitive patterns on the creature's name / id the effect suits (+9).

defence.description: A self-protecting card (the monster mix's defensive pick; npc casts it as defence).

ai.description: Bots cannot drive it: never a thematic pick, never cast by npcPlan.

contact.description: A defensive / control cast only with an enemy in contact.

heals_self.description: Also sensible when the caster is hurt.

ui.description: chaosd6.effect/2 only (effect isolation F8): presentation hints for the browser / Godot HUD.

target_hint.description: The targeting help line while the card is selected.

toast_hits.description: Its effect-result toast lists every unit hit.

perm_help.description: The perms-strip tooltip while it stands.
